max_isometric_tendon_force_N.meaning: Maximum isometric force projected along the tendon; do not multiply by pennation cosine twice.

optimal_fiber_length_m.meaning: Optimal fascicle/fiber length, not whole muscle-tendon length.

pennation_cosine.meaning: Cosine of the constant fiber-to-tendon pennation angle.

tendon_strain_at_max_force.meaning: Tendon extension/slack length at one maximum isometric tendon force.

max_fiber_speed_optimal_lengths_per_s.meaning: Positive maximum-shortening speed magnitude, measured in optimal fiber lengths per second.

normalized_fiber_damping.meaning: Coefficient of normalized fiber velocity in the normalized tendon-direction force balance.

MT_path_length_offset_m.meaning: Constant offset added to the routed path to define muscle-tendon length.

active_force_length_exponent.meaning: Exponent rho in the source active force-length curve.

source_shortening_curvature.meaning: Source shortening-curve coefficient; inactive when De Groote force-velocity mode is selected.

source_lengthening_curvature.meaning: Source lengthening-curve coefficient; inactive when De Groote force-velocity mode is selected.

passive_fiber_enabled.meaning: 1 enables passive fiber tension within the elastic equilibrium; zero force below l_f/l_opt=1 does not mean it is disabled.

degroote_force_velocity_enabled.meaning: 1 uses the documented De Groote/OpenSim velocity curve; 0 uses the source curve.

switch_smoothing_width.meaning: Width of native smooth switching between time constants; zero uses the piecewise equation.
